{{recipe}}

'''Feijao tropeiro''' is a traditional side dish in many parts of Brazil. 

==Ingredients==
*2 [[Cookbook:Pound|lbs]] pinto [[Cookbook:bean|beans]]
*2 lbs [[Cookbook:sausage|sausage]] of your choice (mild Italian is good in this dish)
*2 cloves [[Cookbook:garlic|garlic]]
*2 small yellow [[Cookbook:Onion|onions]]
*½ [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] slab [[Cookbook:Bacon|bacon]]
*4 [[Cookbook:Hard Boiled Eggs|hard boiled eggs]]
*1 bunch [[Cookbook:Green Onion|green onions]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
*1 bunch [[Cookbook:Collard Green|collard greens]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]

==Procedure==
#Prepare beans according to their package. Drain and set aside to cool.
#In large pan, cook bacon and sausage. Remove sausage and bacon.
#Slice sausage into 1 [[Cookbook:Inch|inch]]-thick pieces.
#In the pan with bacon grease, [[Cookbook:Sautéing|sauté]] white onion and garlic.
#[[Cookbook:Slicing|Slice]] collard green into small (⅛-inch) strips.
#Mix all ingredients except hard-boiled eggs in large bowl using a wooden spoon.
#Drizzle with olive oil and stir gently.
#Garnish with sliced boiled eggs.
#Serve hot or cold.
